title: Preview: adjusting paragraphs by clicking them and from their menu, and the AdjList
events: Turn off updating the PDF after each change, and print, so there is a preview to click in
Shift + Right-Click RUT 1:8: one line longer
Ctrl + Left-Click RUT 1:11, which runs on into the next column: shrink its text
Expand both RUT 2:4, from the menu
Shrink RUT 1:3 by a line too, then reset it from the menu: its adjustments go
Ctrl + Middle-Click RUT 1:8 resets it too
The second paragraph of verse 1:4 is a heading: Edit Style takes us to \s in the style editor, and the change goes to \s
Save, and print with the changes
